title: One vehicle opening visible from the street per 20 m of street frontage
text: Vehicle access is limited to one opening per 20m street frontage that is visible from the street.

evaluator.label: one opening per 20 m of frontage

notes: verify: read as at most one opening per whole 20 m of frontage, with at least one allowed (frontage under 40 m: 1; 40-59.9 m: 2). parking.access.count read as vehicle openings visible from the street; site.frontage_m as the street frontage. round(x - 0.4999) is floor.

verified.note: p43 wording confirmed verbatim ('one opening per 20m street frontage that is visible from the street'); it does not say whether a part 20 m earns an opening, nor whether 'visible from the street' qualifies the opening or the frontage.
